notes.password: The admin password 'heiwa_admin_2024' is set as a fallback in the code. In production, it should be set via environment variables (ADMIN_PASSWORD or NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD).
notes.cookie: Admin authentication uses a cookie named 'admin_auth' with value matching the password. Cookie is set with 7-day expiration.
notes.middleware: All /admin routes are protected by middleware that checks for the admin_auth cookie. Invalid or missing cookie redirects to /admin/login.
notes.bookingWidget: The booking widget is a modal that slides in from the right. It can be opened from multiple places (header BOOK button, surf weeks table, etc.).
notes.autoAdvance: Room selection does NOT auto-advance (user must click Next). Surf week selection DOES auto-advance (300ms delay).
notes.scrollBehavior: When navigating to Review & Pay step, the content area scrolls to top to ensure review section is visible.
